maya: Flagging Brightline — onboarding stalled, renewal in ~60d. Usage down ~35% last 30d. Pls help construct a short save plan.

 diego: Ack. Can you drop the key failure points? :thinking: 

 maya: onboarding checklist shows: analytics not connected, two transformer models not validated, 1x SSO issue blocking admin users. Customer reported confusion on prompt templates.

 li-wei: I own the onboarding flow. I can run a condensed enablement workshop this week. Need AE to confirm admin access fix and a contact.

 samira: Jordan (customer CSM) says they hit a budget review next Tue. I can offer a temporary 15% credit for next 2 months tied to activation milestones. Jordan, can you confirm decision authority? :eyes: 

 jordan-ae: Confirmed — CFO is decision maker, but Head of Product will drive activation. I'll join the workshop and escalate SSO with our Support SRE.

 onboard-bot: Added Brightline to 'high-risk' list and created ticket CS-6198.

 maya: Proposed short save plan (2-week sprint):
 ```
 - Day 0: Quick triage call (CS + AE + Onboarding) — owner: jordan-ae
 - Day 1-3: SSO escalation + interim admin token for setup — owner: samira
 - Day 2-5: Enablement workshop (2x 90m) + template modernization — owner: li-wei
 - Day 3-10: Model validation support & perf baseline (run with smaller seq len) — owner: eng-ml (diego support)
 - Day 7: Usage milestone review + 15% credit kickoff if 3/4 activation milestones met — owner: maya
 - Day 14: Decision checkpoint; success -> continue, failure -> downgrade path discussion (preserve data export timeline)
 ```

 diego: I'll run a quick perf check and create a private inference profile with higher KV cache TTL to reduce cold-start cost during validation.

 samira: I'll draft the Customer Success Offer message and approval steps for finance. Will post by EOD.

 li-wei: Workshop slots: Thu 10am or Fri 2pm PT. Jordan, which works?

 jordan-ae: Thu 10am PT works. I'll lock calendar and invite Head of Product.

 maya: Action items consolidated:
 - jordan-ae: Lock triage call + invite stakeholders
 - samira: Interim admin token + credit doc
 - li-wei: Workshop agenda + template repo link
 - diego: Perf profile + short runbook for model validation
 - maya: Update CS-6198 with milestones and monitor usage

 Please add any blockers. If no objections, I'll kick off triage today. :thumbsup:

 samira: No objections. Go ahead.

 jordan-ae: On it. Thanks team.
